title: Analyses of key gene networks controlling carotenoid metabolism in Xiangfen 1 banana.
authors: Dong, Chen; Wang, Jiuxiang; Hu, Yulin; Xiao, Weijun; Hu, Huigang; Xie, Jianghui
one_liner_zh: 该文通过代谢组和转录组分析香蕉果实类胡萝卜素代谢相关基因网络，仅涉及转录因子基因表达共表达网络，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Banana fruits are rich in various high-value metabolites and play a key role in the human diet. Of these components, carotenoids have attracted considerable attention due to their physiological role and human health care functions. However, the accumulation patterns of carotenoids and genome-wide analysis of gene expression during banana fruit development have not been comprehensively evaluated. RESULTS: In the present study, an integrative analysis of metabolites and transcriptome profiles in banana fruit with three different development stages was performed. A total of 11 carotenoid compounds were identified, and most of these compounds showed markedly higher abundances in mature green and/or mature fruit than in young fruit. Results were linked to the high expression of carotenoid synthesis and regulatory genes in the middle and late stages of fruit development. Co-expression network analysis revealed that 79 differentially expressed transcription factor genes may be responsible for the regulation of LCYB (lycopene beta-cyclase), a key enzyme catalyzing the biosynthesis of alpha- and beta-carotene. CONCLUSIONS: Collectively, the study provided new insights into the understanding of dynamic changes in carotenoid content and gene expression level during banana fruit development.
abstract_zh: 背景：香蕉果实富含多种高价值代谢物，在人类饮食中扮演关键角色。在这些成分中，类胡萝卜素因其生理作用和对人类健康的保健功能而受到广泛关注。然而，香蕉果实发育过程中类胡萝卜素的积累模式及基因表达的全基因组分析尚未得到全面评估。结果：本研究对三个不同发育阶段的香蕉果实进行了代谢物和转录组谱的整合分析。共鉴定出11种类胡萝卜素化合物，其中大多数化合物在成熟绿果和/或成熟果实中的丰度显著高于幼果。这些结果与果实发育中后期类胡萝卜素合成及调控基因的高表达相关。共表达网络分析显示，79个差异表达转录因子基因可能负责调控LCYB（番茄红素β-环化酶），该酶是催化α-和β-胡萝卜素生物合成的关键酶。结论：总体而言，本研究为理解香蕉果实发育过程中类胡萝卜素含量和基因表达水平的动态变化提供了新见解。
